devfolders.appHint: App container the folder is mounted into.
devfolders.createHint: Create and remove ask for the administrator password. In Moodle, after applying, open Site administration → Notifications to install or upgrade the plugin.
devfolders.destHint: Folder relative to {root}. It must be empty or not exist yet.
devfolders.destHintCombo: Folder relative to {root}, inside api/ (PHP) or app/ (Node). It must be empty or not exist yet.
devfolders.devFolderHint: Where the code is developed. It can be empty.
devfolders.intro: Mount a development folder inside a Perci82 Dev app container. It shows as an ordinary folder inside the app's project, in the editor and in the container.
devfolders.loadFailed: Couldn't load the Development Folders screen: {error}
devfolders.locked: Type and name read from the development folder's version.php: {component}.
devfolders.noApps: No app container — create one in Docker → Create Container
devfolders.removeConfirm: Unmount "{name}" from the app {app}? The development folder isn't changed, and the app's container (and Nginx, when it serves the app) is restarted.
devfolders.status.appliedHint: The app's container (and Nginx, when it serves the app) already sees the folder.
devfolders.status.inactiveHint: The mount on the host isn't active. Remove it and create it again.
devfolders.status.missingHint: This app's container no longer exists.
devfolders.status.pendingHint: Mounted on the host. Use "Restart container" on this row to apply it.
devfolders.status.stoppedHint: Mounted on the host. It applies when the container starts.
docker.editLoadFailed: Couldn't load the data to edit: {error}
docker.field.dbAccessHint: Create a MariaDB container first to enable this.
docker.field.name: App name
docker.listEmpty: No Docker container registered yet — create one in Docker → Create Container.
docker.migrateConfirm: Replace the old commands of "{name}" (php-{folder}, composer-{folder}…) with the command {folder}? The container is not recreated.
docker.mkcertAlert: First creation: Perci82 Dev generates a local certificate with mkcert. If that asks for an administrator password and hangs, open a terminal outside Perci82 Dev and run mkcert -install by hand once before clicking Create.
docker.nginxNoParams: The Nginx container has no parameters — it routes every *.localhost already set up.
docker.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}"? This doesn't delete html/data on disk.
docker.restoreConfirm: Restore the selected backup? This overwrites MariaDB's current data.
docker.tools.hint: The command named after the folder (e.g. shop composer install) runs PHP and the checked tools inside the container.
docker.tools.title: Tools of the app's command
docker.updateImageApp: Update the image of "{name}" to the newest fix of the same version? Every container that uses the same image is recreated.
docker.updateImageKept: Files, databases and mounted folders are kept; if nothing changed, nothing is recreated.
docker.updateImageMariaDB: Update MariaDB's image to the newest fix of the same version? Before the container is recreated, a full database backup is saved in ~/.perci/appstack/backups (MariaDB must be running).
docker.updateImageNginx: Update Nginx's image to the newest fix of the same version and recreate the container?
docker.updateImagesConfirm: Update the images of every container to the newest fixes of the same versions? Only the containers whose image changed are recreated; MariaDB gets a full backup first, in ~/.perci/appstack/backups (it must be running). Files, databases and mounted folders are kept.
docker.updateImagesHint: Pulls the newest fixes of the images (same PHP, Node, Nginx and MariaDB versions) and recreates only the containers that changed. Files, databases and mounted folders are kept.
logs.title: Logs — {name}
settings.tray: Show Perci82 Dev in the system tray
settings.trayHelp: When on: closing the main window hides it in the tray instead of quitting Perci82 Dev (use "Quit" in the icon's menu to quit for good), and Perci82 Dev starts hidden in the tray with the graphical session. The icon needs an environment with StatusNotifierItem support — it works natively on KDE, XFCE and COSMIC; on GNOME it only shows with the "AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support" extension installed.
terminals.removeStarshipConfirm: Removes the Starship binary and its startup lines in bash, zsh and fish. The configuration (~/.config/starship.toml) is kept as starship.toml.perci-bak.
transfer.commands: Commands that will run inside the containers:
transfer.existsRecreated: already here — it will be recreated
transfer.exportEmpty: Nothing to export yet — create a container in Docker → Create Container or mount a folder in Docker → Development Folders.
transfer.exportIntro: Choose what to export. The file keeps only the definitions — containers and mounted development folders —, not the projects' files nor the databases. MariaDB's credentials go in plain text: keep the file as a secret.
transfer.importConfirm: The checked items are created or replace the ones with the same folder, and their containers are recreated; nothing else on this machine changes. Continue?
transfer.importIntro: Choose an exported file and check what to import. The checked items are created or replace the ones with the same folder; nothing else on this machine changes.
transfer.mariadbDesc: Shared database and its credentials (in plain text in the file).
transfer.mountsNeedPassword: Mounting the folders asks for the administrator password.
transfer.note.appMissingHere: "{name}" depends on the app {app}, which is neither checked nor on this machine: the folder will be skipped.
transfer.note.appNeeded: "{name}" depends on the app {app}: it must already exist on the machine that imports the file.
transfer.note.dbMissingHere: "{app}" uses the database and MariaDB doesn't exist on this machine: check MariaDB.
transfer.note.dbNeeded: "{app}" uses the database: MariaDB must already exist on the machine that imports the file.
transfer.note.nginxMissingHere: "{app}" depends on Nginx, which doesn't exist on this machine: the app has no URL until Nginx is created.
transfer.note.nginxNeeded: "{app}" depends on Nginx: it must already exist on the machine that imports the file.
